names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 3 Δεκεμβρίου, «Όσιος Θεόδουλος “ο από επάρχων”», with the rank word left off. The page's own epithet is «ὁ ἀπὸ ἐπάρχων», the one from among the eparchs; the city in this folder's name is the Edessa it says he went to.

floruit.note: saint.gr: «Υπήρξε πατρίκιος στα χρόνια του Θεοδοσίου του Μεγάλου (379-395)». The page gives no year of birth and none of death; the forty years on the pillar and the age of forty-two at which he climbed it are its own figures and are left in the life rather than turned into a date.

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 3 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the page, and it prints no hymn and no year of death. The same day keeps a second Theodulus, the Cypriot fool for Christ, who is drafted as his own folder; the two are distinguished on the page by their epithets and by their whole story.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 16.12.2025 (3. децембар ст. ст.) — „Преподобни Теодул.“

attestations.note: The day’s fourth entry, quoted whole with its closing full stop; URL year 2025. THE DAY’S ONE IDENTIFICATION, and it is made on the body and not the name: the Greek 3 December carries two Theoduli, `theodulus-the-cypriot` the fool-for-christ and this one, and the book’s four lines are this one’s and no other’s — «Знаменити патриције на двору Теодосија Великог. По смрти своје жене остави сујету света», a famous patrician at the court of Theodosius the Great who after the death of his wife left the vanity of the world for a pillar, which is the eparch-turned-stylite this folder holds and not the Cypriot. NO `sr` NAME FORM, AND IT IS A REFUSAL: the heading prints a rank and a bare forename and nothing else, so stripping «Преподобни» (the `venerable` grade already held) leaves «Теодул», which `sr-foldpred.mjs` measures at FOUR other holders — a bare forename beside fuller ones is the fold BRIEF-SERBIAN §6 warns of, there is nothing in the heading to widen it with, and no key is written for a form that would not tell him from four other men. `types` UNTOUCHED: «Преподобни» is `venerable`, and `stylite` and `ascetic` are the pillar and the thirty years. `dates` UNTOUCHED: the book gives no year at all, naming only the reign of Theodosius the Great, which is the interval 379–395 the folder already carries off saint.gr. TWO DISAGREEMENTS RECORDED AND NEITHER RESOLVED. The book puts the pillar «код Ефеса», by EPHESUS, where saint.gr sent him to EDESSA — the city in this folder’s own display name — and it gives him «пуних тридесет година» on it, a full THIRTY years, where saint.gr gave forty after a climb at the age of forty-two. Nothing was renamed, no `locations` key was made, and both readings are in the life, which is `docs/CORPUS.md` §3. `related` UNTOUCHED: `theodosius-the-great` is already `related` both ways and is the only person the entry names. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.
